attchmntText: Indo-National Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo National Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 12, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 23399.90 lakhs and a profit after tax of 217.91 lakhs. The basic and diluted earnings per share stood at 2.91. The company invested in compulsory convertible preference shares of Aidin Technologies Pvt. Ltd. The amalgamation of Helios Strategic Systems Limited with Indo National Limited became effective on April 2, 2026. The company also noted a stay on a Competition Commission of India penalty of 4226 lakhs following a deposit of 422 lakhs. Financial figures are presented in lakhs of rupees.
